_readme: Nu HTML Checker tuning. 'patterns': ERRORS that are expected in email HTML (reported as known exceptions, not flagged). 'important_warnings': the only WARNINGS that are surfaced (as WARN, never FLAG); every other warning is ignored. Patterns are regexes on the validator message.

patterns.pattern: The “(bgcolor|align|valign|cellpadding|cellspacing|border|background|bordercolor)” attribute on the “\w+” element is obsolete
patterns.why: Presentational table attributes required by Outlook
VML/Office namespaces and Apple data detectors

important_warnings.pattern: character encoding was not declared|encoding .* declared
important_warnings.why: No charset — special characters/emoji can garble
Missing lang — screen readers pick the wrong voice

important_warnings.pattern: Document uses the Unicode Private Use Area
Text run is not in Unicode Normalization Form C
